title.narrative: Promote Youth Participation in Policy Development and Strengthen Youth Knowledge

description.narrative: This activity will focus on implementation of Performance Indicators 1 and 2 and specifically design two main actions to deliver results at the end of the 43 C/5. The first strategic focus will support youth-led knowledge generation and production on social and contemporary issues affecting young people in the region, within the framework of the Youth As Researchers (YAR) programme. Here, this intervention will leverage the use of the YAR Technical Guide and Training Modules, along with the support of the new UNITWIN Network on the General History of Africa (GHA), to facilitate successful execution of research projects, culminating in the generation of knowledge products to serve as the basis for further actions, including policy dialogues and intergenerational engagements. The second action will mobilize and support training of English-speaking youth trainers on the use and application of UNESCO Toolbox on Policy and Programme. Once trained, these young trainers will serve as an important resource to support Members States utilizing the toolbox for range of issues, from intergenerational dialogues on peacebuilding, and social cohesion, to youth engagement in the prevention of electoral violence, in their specific contexts.
